check_is_oss: check if the current environment is running in open-source mode by calling is_oss
check_decorator_registration: check if a given function or class has the fb_overwritable decorator registered
apply_fb_overwritable_decorator: apply the fb_overwritable decorator to a function to enable internal implementation swapping
review_fb_overwritable_decorator: review the fb_overwritable decorator logic that swaps OSS functions with FB-internal implementations
summarize_oss_utils: summarize the oss_utils module that provides open-source detection and function overwriting utilities
